title: Create post
readOnly: You can only view this post.

brief.title: Brief
brief.label: What is it about?
brief.placeholder: Topic, occasion, key facts and links. The AI never invents numbers or quotes.
brief.briefRequired: Please describe in the brief what the post is about first.

replace.title: Replace the existing texts?
replace.description: The AI rewrites all variants. Texts you are editing right now stay as they are.

storytelling.name: Storytelling
storytelling.description: A short, concrete story with a takeaway.

educational.name: Educational
educational.description: Explains one useful thing step by step.

thought_leadership.name: Thought leadership
thought_leadership.description: A reasoned position on a trend.

promotional.name: Promotional
promotional.description: Presents an offer with a clear benefit.

variants.title: Variants
variants.empty: Choose platforms and let the AI write the variants.
variants.overLimit: The text is too long for {platform}.
variants.invalidHashtag: Hashtags consist of letters, digits and underscores.
variants.firstCommentHint: Published as a comment right after the post.
variants.forbidden: Forbidden words of the brand voice: {words}
variants.notOverwritten: {count, plural, one {One variant you edited was} other {# variants you edited were}} not overwritten.

refine.title: Refine
refine.customPlaceholder: For example: Mention the opening on Friday.
refine.running: The AI is revising the text ...

diff.title: Review the suggestion
diff.description: Removed words are struck through, new ones highlighted.

conflict.title: Changed in the meantime
conflict.description: Someone changed this post since you opened it. Load the new state, or overwrite it with your changes.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: When and on which account the variants appear.
schedule.saveFirst: Once the post has a brief and a platform, it is saved and can be scheduled.
schedule.noAccounts: No account is connected for {platform} yet.
schedule.planned: {count, plural, one {# variant scheduled.} other {# variants scheduled.}}
schedule.posting: {count, plural, one {# variant is being published now.} other {# variants are being published now.}}

confirmNow.title: Publish now?
confirmNow.description: {count, plural, one {# variant goes} other {# variants go}} to the platforms right away. This cannot be undone.

hints.needsReauth: {account} must be reconnected before it can post.
hints.expiresBefore: The access to {account} ends on {date}, before the scheduled time. Reconnect the account first.
hints.xCost: Posts through the X API cost money. So far for {account}: {amount}.
hints.locked: This variant is being published or was published. Its text and media can no longer change.
hints.needsAttention: It is unclear whether this variant appeared. Check the platform and decide.

warnings.ACCESS_EXPIRES_BEFORE_PUBLISH: {platform}: The access of the account ends before the scheduled time.
warnings.ACCOUNT_EXPIRING: {platform}: The access of the account expires soon.
